answer: Lantern-Gale Soundscape Proof — $40 per fake: each identity must answer the lantern beacon's random whisper challenge by recording 5 seconds of live ambient audio, matched against the public gale soundscape feed for its claimed place and minute. A replayed clip fails the timestamp match; a synthesized one fails the wind spectrum. Each fake needs its own live microphone in a real location, so 1,000 fakes cost $40,000 and 1,000 separate sites.
